description: DTM - Densità di drenaggio is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ambiente.regione.emilia-romagna.it. RASTER data (ESRI GRID format), consisting of square cells of 10m side.The values of each cell represent the Drainage Density, expressed in [m/mq] and calculated on a circular circle of 200m radius from the cell itself. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "DTM - Drainage density" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
